    Methods in sysmlinjava.ports that return SysMLAnything
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    protected SysMLAnything
    SysMLPort.clientObjectFor(SysMLAnything serverObject)
    Overridable operation to transform (decapsulate) the specified lower-level protocol object into a upper-level protocol object.
    Note:Extensions of SysMLPort must override and implement this operation if this port is a "client" port for a lower-level protocol that receives SysMLAnything-based objects from a "server" port for an upper-level protocol and decapsulates them for an opper-level protocol.
    protected SysMLAnything
    SysMLPort.clientObjectFor(SysMLSignal signal)
    Overridable operation to transform the object in the specified signal into a SysMLAnything-based object.
    Note:Extensions of SysMLPort must override and implement this operation if this port is a peer-level protocol port that receives SysML-based signals from peer-level port(s) and extracts SysMLAnything-based objects from the signal for transmission to "client" ports.
    protected SysMLAnything
    SysMLPort.serverObjectFor(SysMLAnything clientObject)
    Overridable operation to transform the specified upper-level protocol object into a lower-level protocol object.
    Note:Extensions of SysMLPort must override and implement this operation if this port is a "server" port that receives SysMLAnything-based objects from a "client" port for an upper-level protocol and encapsulates them for a lower-level protocol.
    Methods in sysmlinjava.ports with parameters of type SysMLAnything
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    protected SysMLAnything
    SysMLPort.clientObjectFor(SysMLAnything serverObject)
    Overridable operation to transform (decapsulate) the specified lower-level protocol object into a upper-level protocol object.
    Note:Extensions of SysMLPort must override and implement this operation if this port is a "client" port for a lower-level protocol that receives SysMLAnything-based objects from a "server" port for an upper-level protocol and decapsulates them for an opper-level protocol.
    protected SysMLEvent
    SysMLPort.eventFor(SysMLAnything object)
    Overridable operation to transform the specified object into a SysMLEvent-based event.
    Note:Extensions of SysMLPort must override and implement this operation if this port is a "client" port that receives SysMLAnything-based objects from "server" ports and generates SysMLEvents for the eventContextPart that contains the objects for the eventContextPart.
    void
    SysMLPort.receive(SysMLAnything object)
    Receives an object.
    protected SysMLAnything
    SysMLPort.serverObjectFor(SysMLAnything clientObject)
    Overridable operation to transform the specified upper-level protocol object into a lower-level protocol object.
    Note:Extensions of SysMLPort must override and implement this operation if this port is a "server" port that receives SysMLAnything-based objects from a "client" port for an upper-level protocol and encapsulates them for a lower-level protocol.
    protected SysMLSignal
    SysMLPort.signalFor(SysMLAnything object)
    Overridable operation to transform (encapsulate) the specified upper-level protocol object into a SysMLSignal-based signal.
    Note:Extensions of SysMLPort must override and implement this operation if this port is a "server" port that receives SysMLAnything-based objects from a "client" port for an upper-level protocol or from another SysMLPart object and encapsulates them into a SysML-based signal for transmission to a peer-level protocol port.
    void
    SysMLPort.transmit(SysMLAnything object)
    Transmits an object.
